_note: CommonSpirit fiscal year ends June 30. FY2020 ended 2020-06-30 (COVID impact year).

moodys.citation_text: Moody's held CommonSpirit at Baa1 stable across the window. The 2024 upgrade to A3 references pre-upgrade rating as Baa1 — consistent multi-year holding.

sp.citation_text: S&P held BBB+ entering window. S&P upgraded to A- from BBB+ in Nov 2021 (in-window) confirming BBB+ was the prior rating.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch held BBB+ stable entering window; outlook revised positive Nov 2021.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: S&P upgraded CommonSpirit from BBB+ to A-, citing progress integrating CHI-Dignity merger operations, cost efficiency identification, strong management team, and strategic operating approach.
Fitch revised outlook to positive from stable; expected operating EBIDTA of 6.5-7.5% over next four years.

outcome_class_rationale: CommonSpirit received S&P UPGRADE (BBB+ to A-) and Fitch POSITIVE OUTLOOK in Nov 2021. Moody's held Baa1 stable but did not upgrade until Feb 2024 (out-of-window). Within window, the rating signal was clearly positive — driven by integration progress and post-COVID operating recovery despite FY2020 $550M operating loss.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: CommonSpirit FY2020 reported $550M operating loss on $29B revenue (40% volume drop in mid-March). Largest non-profit hospital system; integration of CHI + Dignity ongoing. _warning: total revenue and balance sheet line items estimated from system scale and ProPublica references.

ma_events_2021_2022.rationale: CommonSpirit disclosed Sept 2021 sale of part of stake in unnamed JV. Limited materiality.
